France Submits $34 Billion Rafale Proposal to India

The French government has submitted a proposal to the Indian government to manufacture 94 Rafale fighter jets in India, with an estimated cost of $34 billion. The proposal includes plans for large-scale local manufacturing. France claims that this will increase India's military capabilities.
